label: Just held
title: Election result
text: The result of the First General Election is published. Until the evening of Monday 16 November 2026, a member may say that a vote under his name was not cast by him.

label: Coming up
title: Directors' vote
text: The Board of Directors elects the CEO, the CFO and the Women's Director live on Google Meet on Friday 20 November 2026 at 9:00 PM, Pakistan time.

label: Open for reading
title: Constitution and Rule Book drafts
text: The drafts can still change until 30 November 2026. They come into force on 3 December 2026.

label: Coming up
title: 3 December 2026
text: The Constitution and the Rule Book come into force, and the first terms of the Core Committee begin.
